Daily Devotional

November 21

28 There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus. 29 And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise. (Galatians 3:28-29 KJV)

If you are a born again Christian it does not matter what your race, occupation, or gender is, you are “one in Christ Jesus”. So all of us are the same, and are all brothers and sisters in Christ, with no distinction made as to what we are in the physical world. This is wonderful, as it means that we are all equal in God’s eyes, and no distinction is ever made as to our natural man, putting us all on an equal basis with God. This is what it means when it says we are new creatures (2 Corinthians 5:17), as in God’s sight we all are the same – children of His. This means that the Christian should look on all his brothers and sisters in Christ, as being the same, as we should look on the spirit, and not the physical being, of all other Christians. This should do away with all prejudice for the Christian, if we will just do this.

Wow! All of us Christians are Abraham’s seed, and heirs of the promises made to him. If you read the bible about all the wonderful things God has promised to Abraham, and realize that we have those promises now, then you will be more informed as to what God has blessed us with. We get all the benefits that Jesus has, and are joint heirs with Him (Romans 8:17), of all that the Father has. When the bible says we are blessed with all spiritual blessings (Ephesians 1:3), this is what it is telling us. With the Spirit of Christ living in us, we can be healed, prospered, delivered, and blessed beyond anything we could hope for, by just putting faith in what we have been given. We not only have all these blessings, but we have been redeemed from all the curses of the law (Galatians 3:13). It is so wonderful just to be forgiven of all our sins, but God did so much more, by giving us all the blessings also. This is the Grace of God to us, His children. Thank you Lord for all you have done.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
